reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Create a fresh one-use code for this same installation at {portal_url}. Only the access key will change. Your sensor choices, polarity, strings and sending preference will stay unchanged. If sending is paused, reconnecting will not enable it.

data.consent: I confirm reconnecting this installation to the same portal

user.title: Pair your installation
user.description: Create a 10-minute, one-use pairing code in the portal. Never enter your Home Assistant access token.

measurements.title: Confirm sensors
measurements.description: GoodWe PV sources are suggested from the registry. Select either a combined PV total OR individual inverter PV sources, never both. AC output may include battery power. Household consumption and grid must be selected once, not summed across inverters. Units W/kW are converted automatically.

data.pv_strings: Individual PV strings — separate breakdown, not added to total

confirm.title: Confirm polarity and consent
confirm.description: Check grid and battery polarity. GoodWe normally uses positive export and discharge. This integration only sends selected readings and never controls devices. Pause sending in integration options.

data.consent: I consent to sending selected readings to this portal

error.wrong_installation: This code belongs to a different installation. Existing settings were not changed. Revoke the unused key for that installation in the portal and create a code for the correct one.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS URL without credentials, query or fragment.
error.invalid_pairing: Invalid, expired or used code. Create a new pairing code.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach portal. If pairing was already consumed, revoke the unused key and create a new code.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected response. Portal version 1.3.0 is required.
error.consent_required: Confirm consent to send these readings.
error.missing_sensor: Sensor is not present in HA.
error.invalid_unit: Power units must be W or kW; battery SOC must use %. Do not select kWh counters.
error.duplicate_sensor: Do not select the same sensor more than once.

abort.reauth_successful: Access key updated. All existing sensor choices and settings have been preserved.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The existing installation does not match. Its configuration was not changed.
abort.already_configured: Already configured. Revoke the newly created unused portal key; use Options to edit the existing integration.
